activity_summary: You kept the parish hour with the almanac open on the fifth and the sixth. Master Thwaite turned the glass twice. The margin beside Monday stayed empty. Three pews ahead, the Lord Mayor's back did not turn.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat the hour with the almanac on his knee and made no mark.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Preached, and turned the sand-glass twice.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat three pews ahead, turned away, and did not speak.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Mentioned in The fifth, and an empty sixth
